intro.text: Lanacin the Surefooted, a figure from Rosharan history.
Lanacin the Surefooted, a figure from Rosharan history who is said to have killed a Shardbearer and won a Shardblade.

items.text: Kaladin knew Lanacin's story. To him, the tales of men like Lanacin and Evod Markmaker showed that darkeyes in Alethkar had fewer chances to rise than they once did.
